verses.raw: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."
verses.text: But Satan caused them to slip out of it and removed them from that [condition] in which they had been. And We said, "Go down, [all of you], as enemies to one another, and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time."

verses.raw: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words,<sup foot_note=254031>1</sup> and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance,<sup foot_note=254030>2</sup> the Merciful.
verses.text: Then Adam received from his Lord [some] words, and He accepted his repentance. Indeed, it is He who is the Accepting of Repentance, the Merciful.
